newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CSR says Gove bauxite output rises.
newsitem.headline: CSR says Gove bauxite output rises.

text.p: CSR Ltd said on Friday that Gove Aluminium Ltd's share of production from the Gove bauxite project in the Northern Territory of Australia rose to 454,000 tonnes in the March quarter from 410,000 tonnes a year ago.

The company, which has a financial year ending March 31, said Gove Aluminium's share of annual output was virtually steady at 1.918 million tonnes from 1.915 million tonnes a year ago. CSR owns 70 percent of Gove Aluminium, which has a 30 percent stake in the Gove project. The remainder is held by the local unit of Alusuisse-Lonza Holdings Ltd.
